描述_EN: a narrow band of fret pattern and peonies divides this border from the next, depicting birds including peacock, crane, mandarin duck and phoenix amidst flowering branches of prunus blossom, peony, magnolia, and lotus; at the bottom are three dogs of fo. it is a celebratory hanging for mr huang's 90th birthday; a long inscription bearing the names of the donors in gold leaf is embroidered on crimson ground. from the top of the hanging suspend two narrow pendants decorated with taoist letters, bats, citrus fruits and lotus blossoms. at the top is a five-clawed dragon in between two phoenixes with clouds in the background. hanging panel of red silk satin embroidered with silver thread and coloured silks in satin and stem stitches, with couched work. another border shows a scene on the top: an emperor and empress surrounded with attendants are seated by a shrine before which a small figure is kneeling in worship. the sides and bottom of this border is filled with depictions of figures in landscape or pavilions. around it is a border of fret pattern and peonies and chou characters.
描述_ZN: a narrow band of fret pattern and peonies divides this border from the next, depicting birds including peacock, crane, mandarin duck and phoenix amidst flowering branches of prunus blossom, peony, magnolia, and lotus; at the bottom are three dogs of fo. it is a celebratory hanging for mr huang's 90th birthday; a long inscription bearing the names of the donors in gold leaf is embroidered on crimson ground. 从挂件的顶部悬挂着两个狭长的吊坠，上面装饰着道教字母、蝙蝠、柑橘和荷花。 顶部是一条五爪龙在两只凤凰之间，背景是云彩。 挂件为红色绸缎，用银线和彩色丝线绣成的缎纹和茎纹，有凹槽。 另一个边框显示了顶部的场景：皇帝和皇后在侍从的簇拥下坐在神龛旁，神龛前有一个小人物正跪拜着。 这个边框的两侧和底部充满了山水或亭台楼阁中的人物描写。 周围有一圈花纹、牡丹和周字的边框。
